units.name: Academic Department of Operations & Technology
units.evidence: School academic-department page names Operations & Technology and describes manufacturing/service-system decisions, logistics, supply chains and operations research; lists department head and related professors.

decisions.reason: Slash-separated recruiting disciplines are not a department name. Official operations department verified separately; standalone MIS, finance and AI labels are not retained.

sources.note: Header identifies TUM School of Management and Technical University of Munich; body calls department Operations & Supply Chain Management while header says Operation & Technology.
Current school directory consistently uses Operations & Technology, with operations/logistics scope and department head.

limitations: Engineering branch awaits main university record review; this proposal verifies the school alias and business unit only.
Official departmental home retains conflicting older name; school academic directory used for canonical unit name.
